resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts names the Oklahoma Department of Forestry. The state forestry page names Oklahoma Forestry Services within the Department of Agriculture, Food and Forestry. The story reports both names; no source gives the date of any change.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a one-line Forest Lookouts entry (60 ft, southeast of Locust Grove) plus a TopoQuest place entry with matching coordinates. TopoQuest is a gazetteer, not a lookout register; it does not establish that the tower stands. Search snippets (not fetched, not cited) pointed to a RadioReference Oklahoma Forestry frequency near Rose and to FCC antenna records in Rose; both are unverified and do not confirm a lookout. The NHLR Oklahoma list has no Rose entry. The story is about 150 words, above the 120-word floor. The TopoQuest sentence no longer calls TopoQuest a place-name database; the story describes it only by what the entry says.
